decisions.basis: An empty competing target directory must be preserved atomically, including a publication race.
decisions.choice: Use Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE for final directory installation; no check-then-rename fallback.

decisions.basis: No output overwrite or destructive cleanup is needed.
decisions.choice: Write only a private newly created UUID staging directory and content-addressed objects; preserve interrupted/colliding attempts.

decisions.basis: Changing evidence, source version or producer build cannot reuse an old immutable identity.
decisions.choice: Bundle identity binds exact captured file paths/bytes, submitted envelope and producer contract/build.

decisions.basis: A successful early capture does not establish final currentness.
decisions.choice: Recheck every captured artifact and the full selected source snapshot immediately before installation.

decisions.basis: A closed evidence manifest is not a hermetic runtime distribution.
decisions.choice: Close over E01 explicit artifact references and bind external runtime requirement records without copying arbitrary nested path strings.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Interrupted and colliding publication preserves inputs and existing output; modified evidence/version does not reuse an old bundle identity; no frozen registry/schema edits.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Capture a closed manifest; write a private absent staging directory; publish create-only without overwriting competing paths; verify final source currentness; preserve attempts and old evidence.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Interrupted and colliding publication preserves inputs and existing output; modified evidence/version does not reuse an old bundle identity; no frozen registry/schema edits.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
